verdict.rationale: Data-use and training opt-out controls are a fair question for an AI coding CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to opt out of having code or prompts used for model training. The generic 'Enterprise features: Advanced security and compliance' line does not name any training or data-use control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
